title: Festival
description: A festival, held at a festival ground. One file per festival in content/festivals/<id>.json.

seasons.description: The seasons it can be held in; leave out for any season.

cost.description: What it costs to hold; it must ask for something.

culturePerDay.description: Culture it yields per day while running.

seasonBonus.description: An extra culture percentage in one season.

effects.description: Effects (typically modifiers) active while it runs.

start.description: Whether the festival is available from the start without an unlockFestival effect.
